reason: Superseded by the v2 schema (list-valued `modalities`). These files are the frozen record behind the published v1 figures, which are cited on the public walk-through and in external writing. They are NOT regenerable from scripts -- the teacher run is stochastic in ordering and the model behind it drifts -- which is why they are committed against the repo's usual no-data rule.

measurement.note: preds_qwen.jsonl is the raw model output, pre-normalizer. The published headline 0.922 is the raw score; 0.925 is the same predictions after schema/normalize.py snap_to_enum, which shipped later (ADR-0011). verify_v1.py checks both.

training.note: Trained BEFORE the Phase-4 rare-modality augment existed. adapters/qwen_v2 is the +300-row variant (ADR-0011) and is a different artifact.

gold.split_caveat: NOT reproducible: all.jsonl is written in ThreadPoolExecutor completion order, so a fresh teacher run yields a different split. This is why gold_test.jsonl is committed here rather than described.
